claim: Consider finite connected simple undirected equal-quality habitat networks \(G\), compared only at the same vertex count \(n\) and same edge count \(m\). Each occupied patch becomes empty independently at rate \(1\), and an empty patch is colonized at rate \(\lambda\) times the number of occupied adjacent patches, for any \(\lambda>0\). Start with every patch occupied and write \(T_G(\lambda)\) for expected time to the absorbing empty state, and \(\rho(G)\) for adjacency spectral radius (the binary equal-quality metapopulation-capacity proxy). At \(n\le3\) there is no nonisomorphic fixed-\((n,m)\) pair, and for \(n=4,m=3\) the star has larger \(\rho\) and strictly larger \(T\) than the path for every \(\lambda>0\). For \(n=4,m=4\), the only two graph types are the four-cycle \(C_4\) and the paw graph \(P\) (triangle with one pendant vertex), with \(\rho(P)>\rho(C_4)=2\). There is exactly one positive parameter \(\alpha\in(1.079524,1.079525)\) such that \(T_P(\alpha)=T_{C_4}(\alpha)\). For \(0<\lambda<\alpha\), \(T_P(\lambda)>T_{C_4}(\lambda)\), whereas for every \(\lambda>\alpha\), \(T_P(\lambda)<T_{C_4}(\lambda)\); specifically \(T_{C_4}(2)-T_P(2)=237101/648778>0\). The crossover is the unique positive root of \(648\lambda^9+3504\lambda^8+8486\lambda^7+10624\lambda^6+4144\lambda^5-7529\lambda^4-13801\lambda^3-10608\lambda^2-4176\lambda-684\), which has exactly one positive root by Descartes' rule of signs. Thus four patches and four undirected dispersal links are simultaneously minimal for a strict contradiction between an adjacency-spectral landscape-capacity ranking and fully occupied finite-stochastic mean persistence among landscapes with matched patch/link budgets. This comparison is model-specific and does not claim that the original weighted metapopulation-capacity statistic globally orders stochastic persistence.
integrity: Closed rational absorption times are verified against exact state generators and independent full-state rational solutions. A single exact polynomial sign-change argument proves the rate-uniform ranking and unique positive crossing; enumeration over all connected simple graph types through four patches certifies sharp minimality.
scientific_limitations: Strictly the homogeneous binary, undirected, equal-quality finite patch-occupancy model with per-neighbor colonization and independent unit-rate extinction, from full occupancy, at matched patch/link budgets; not a universal conclusion for weighted landscape capacity, nonlinear ecology, immigration, or other starting states. Generic stochastic persistence ranking disagreements are known prior work.
title: Four-patch spectral capacity and stochastic persistence have a unique ranking reversal
